name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Scaled Customer Success & Lifecycle Programs | Retention, Adoption Campaigns, Customer Health
summary: B2B SaaS customer success and account management professional who runs high-volume books through a mix of one-to-many programs and targeted 1:1 work. At Birdeye I managed a reseller channel of 15-20 partners, used utilization signals to catch at-risk accounts early, and retained all but one (~94%). At Wix I carried a book of up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and 25+ launches per month, and drove a 25% conversion improvement across supported accounts. At Solenzo I design and automate lifecycle, onboarding, and reactivation programs, and I use AI tools daily to analyze signals and build customer communication.

experience.title: Lifecycle & Customer Success Programs — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Design and deploy automated lifecycle sequences, onboarding workflows, and reactivation programs that activate, nurture, and retain customers at scale across 20+ production workflows.
Build segmentation, lifecycle stages, and qualification criteria in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, so the right customers get the right touchpoint and qualified opportunities route cleanly to sales.
Report on a regular cadence with actionable insights and recommendations, building dashboards that track funnel progression and outcomes for client leadership.
Identify expansion opportunities with existing clients, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with their goals.
Wrote and published 18 plain-language articles for non-technical business owners on CRM setup, automation, and re-engaging lapsed customers.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran QBRs and built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs for ~3 client accounts at $20K+/month in spend each.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance signals to flag adoption gaps and at-risk accounts early, recommending interventions that reduced churn.
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that scaled onboarding across the partner network and reduced friction.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to carry value to their own end customers.
Shared structured, high-priority customer feedback with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors between teams, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-volume book of up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and 25+ launches per month, holding 110% of implementation and 120% of sales targets.
Drove a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive communication on client goals.
Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria.
Ran weekly training sessions and workshops for onboarding teams of up to 30, plus 1:1 coaching.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Advised professional-services firms on CRM and project-management software adoption, running workshops for client teams on how the platform fit their day-to-day.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct guidance.
